title: Tamsin and the Vector
author: August Crane
blurb: Silas Kavanagh, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before the jump window closes.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
